predicates.title: App Service without authentication on internet-facing app
predicates.description: App Service / Function app authentication (Easy Auth / authsettingsV2) is disabled while the app is internet-facing. The agent confirms whether the app serves sensitive functionality.
predicates.recommendation: Enable App Service authentication or enforce app-level auth; add access restrictions.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.web/sites' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, authEnabled = tobool(properties.siteConfig.authSettingsV2Enabled), publicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)

predicates.title: App Service FTP deployment or remote debugging enabled
predicates.description: Insecure deployment channels (unencrypted FTP, ftpsState=AllAllowed) or remote debugging are enabled on an App Service / Function app.
predicates.recommendation: Set ftpsState to Disabled (or FtpsOnly); disable remote debugging.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.web/sites' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, ftpsState = tostring(properties.siteConfig.ftpsState), remoteDebuggingEnabled = tobool(properties.siteConfig.remoteDebuggingEnabled)

predicates.title: VM without disk encryption
predicates.description: A VM's disks are not protected by Azure Disk Encryption or encryption-at-host, or the VM uses unmanaged disks.
predicates.recommendation: Enable encryption-at-host or ADE; migrate to managed disks.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, encryptionAtHost = tobool(properties.securityProfile.encryptionAtHost), adeEnabled = tobool(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.encryptionSettings.enabled), hasUnmanagedDisk = isnull(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk)
